ToSSec1D: By accessing and using the Wafa Hardware mobile application, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please refrain from using our services.
ToSSec2D: All orders placed through the app are subject to availability. Prices are subject to change without notice. We accept cash on delivery and secure digital payments. Wafa Hardware reserves the right to cancel orders in case of pricing errors or stock discrepancies.
ToSSec3D: We strive to deliver hardware, glass, and tools within 24-48 hours. Delivery charges may apply based on your location in Punjab. Heavy items like plywood or large glass panels may require special handling fees.
ToSSec4D: Hardware items can be returned within 7 days if they are in their original packaging and unused. Custom-cut glass panels or specialized tools cannot be returned once the order is processed. Please inspect all goods upon delivery.
ToSSec5D: Power tools and electronic hardware carry manufacturer warranties where applicable. Wafa Hardware provides a 30-day shop warranty for mechanical defects on selected items. Misuse of tools voids all warranties.
ToSSec6D: Your contact information and address are used solely for order processing and delivery. We do not sell your data to third parties. For more details, please refer to our Privacy Policy section.
ToSFooter: Questions? Contact our support via the Help Center.
PPSec1D: We collect personal information that you provide to us, such as your full name, email address, phone number, and delivery address. This information is gathered during registration or when placing an order.
PPSec2D: Your data is used specifically to fulfill your hardware orders, manage deliveries in Punjab, and provide you with relevant updates about your purchases. We also use it to improve your app experience and provide customer support.
PPSec3D: All user data is stored securely using Firebase. We implement administrative and technical security measures designed to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, use, or disclosure.
PPSec4D: Wafa Hardware does NOT sell your personal data to third parties. We only share information with our delivery teams and payment processors as strictly necessary to fulfill your orders.
PPSec5D: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information at any time through the Profile screen. If you wish to delete your account entirely, please contact our support team via the Help Center.
PPSec6D: The app may send push notifications related to your orders. You can manage these in the App Setup section. We use localized data to save your preferences and theme settings.
PPFooter: Your privacy is our priority. Thank you for trusting Wafa Hardware.
